cards.ex: With the economy slowing down, we all need to tighten our belts.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot sekinlashayotgani sababli, hammamiz xarajatlarni kamaytirishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: It's getting harder and harder for families to make ends meet these days.
cards.exUz: Oilalar uchun hozirgi kunda kun ko'rish tobora qiyinlashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Daromad va xarajatlarni tenglashtirish, yetarli pul topish.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure of how much this project will cost?
cards.exUz: Bu loyiha qancha turishini taxminan ayta olasizmi?

cards.ex: My company will foot the bill for my business trip.
cards.exUz: Mening kompaniyam biznes safarim uchun to'lovni qoplaydi.

cards.ex: This vacation won't break the bank because we're staying in budget hotels.
cards.exUz: Biz byudjet mehmonxonalarida qolayotganimiz sababli, bu ta'til juda qimmatga tushmaydi.

cards.ex: That software is a real cash cow for the company.
cards.exUz: Bu dastur kompaniya uchun haqiqiy daromad manbai.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy daromad keltiradigan biznes yoki mahsulot.

cards.ex: The company has been in the red for the last two quarters.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya oxirgi ikki chorakda qarzda edi.

cards.ex: After years of struggle, the business is finally in the black.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik kurashdan so'ng, biznes nihoyat foydada.

cards.ex: I'm saving money for a rainy day.
cards.exUz: Men qora kun uchun pul yig'yapman.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan qiyin vaziyat uchun pul yig'ish.

cards.ex: We traveled Europe on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Biz Yevropaga juda kam xarajat bilan sayohat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan, tejamkorlik bilan.

cards.ex: You can't just spend money like that, you know money doesn't grow on trees!
cards.exUz: Shunchaki pulni shunday sarflash mumkin emas, bilasanmi pul daraxtda o'smaydi!
cards.uzDef: Pulni osonlik bilan topib bo'lmasligini eslatish.

cards.ex: They've been saving for years to build a nest egg.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'p yillar davomida pul yig'ib kelishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Keksalik yoki boshqa maqsadlar uchun yig'ilgan pul.

cards.ex: After selling his company, he was loaded.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyasini sotgandan so'ng, u juda boy bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda boy bo'lmoq, ko'p pulga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He made a killing on the stock market.
cards.exUz: U fond bozorida katta foyda oldi.

cards.ex: I had to shell out a lot of money for car repairs.
cards.exUz: Men mashinani ta'mirlash uchun ko'p pul to'lashim kerak edi.

cards.ex: Don't skimp on good shoes, they're important for your feet.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi poyabzalga tejamkorlik qilmang, ular oyoqlaringiz uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni sotib olishda kamroq pul sarflash.

cards.ex: This investment is a golden opportunity.
cards.exUz: Bu investitsiya - oltin imkoniyat.

cards.ex: Many people are living paycheck to paycheck these days.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar hozirgi kunda oylikdan oylikka yashashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Oy oxirigacha yetadigan daromad bilan yashash.

cards.ex: The company was accused of cooking the books.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirishda ayblangan edi.

cards.ex: He thought he could make easy money gambling.
cards.exUz: U qimor o'ynab oson pul topishi mumkin deb o'yladi.

cards.ex: I'm flat broke until my next paycheck.
cards.exUz: Keyingi oyligimga qadar men mutlaqo pulim yo'q.

cards.ex: I had to fork over $200 for the parking ticket.
cards.exUz: Men mashina to'xtash joyi uchun 200 dollar to'lashim kerak edi.

cards.ex: Let's go Dutch on the bill tonight.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun har birimiz o'zimizning hisobimizni to'laymiz.
cards.uzDef: Har bir kishi o'zining xarajatlarini to'lashi.

cards.ex: He hit the jackpot when he invested in that company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritganda omadi keldi.

cards.ex: In this world, money talks.
cards.exUz: Bu dunyoda pul gapiradi.

cards.ex: They nickel and dime their employees by cutting benefits.
cards.exUz: Ular xodimlarga imtiyozlarni qisqartirish orqali mayda-chuyda narsalarda tejamkorlik qilishadi.

cards.ex: We had to pay through the nose for tickets to the concert.
cards.exUz: Biz konsertga chiptalar uchun juda qimmat to'lashimiz kerak edi.

cards.ex: I had to shell out a lot of money on my new car.
cards.exUz: Men yangi mashinamga ko'p pul sarflashim kerak edi.

cards.ex: He cashed in on his fame by writing a book.
cards.exUz: U kitob yozib, mashhurligidan foyda ko'rdi.

cards.ex: Since he sold his company, he's been rolling in dough.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyasini sotgandan beri, u pulga cho'milib yashamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda boy bo'lish, ko'p pulga ega bo'lish.
